name: seagrid_reference_infrastructure
description: DISPLAY ONLY. Real-world Romanian Black Sea infrastructure from the documents in assets/ (Rezumat.docx and subfolders) plus public sources within ~500 km of Constanța. APPROXIMATE, illustrative coordinates; not official positions. Not used by detection, scoring, the data generator or eval (those use infrastructure.geojson).

properties.name: Neptun Deep: Domino field (approx.)
properties.note: Deepwater Neptun Deep reservoir (~1,000 m water depth), subsea wells tied back to Neptun Alpha

properties.name: Neptun Deep: Pelican Sud field (approx.)
properties.note: Shallower Neptun Deep reservoir (~125 m water depth); OMV Petrom and Romgaz

properties.name: Neptun Deep main gas pipeline to Tuzla (approx.)
properties.note: ~160 km from Neptun Alpha to the Tuzla metering station (microtunnel landfall)
properties.source: https://www.omvpetrom.com/en/about-us/what-we-do/our-projects/neptun-deep ; assets/Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms/List of Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms.docx

properties.name: Port of Constanța (approx.)
properties.note: Largest Black Sea port: >100 Mt/year, 156 berths, North and South breakwaters
properties.source: assets/Seaports and Naval Defense/List of Ports and Harbors.docx

properties.name: Constanța Maritime Security Hub (approx.)
properties.note: Joint Romania-Bulgaria hub (with Varna) for critical infrastructure monitoring

properties.name: Black Sea Submarine Cable, BSSC (planned route, approx.)
properties.note: Proposed 1,100-1,195 km HVDC power cable, Anaklia (Georgia) to Constanța, with a parallel fibre-optic leg planned alongside
properties.source: https://tyndp.entsoe.eu/explore/explore-future-transmission-storage-projects ; assets/Undersea Power and Data Cables/The Black Sea Submarine Cable (BSSC).docx (route map, Brussels Institute for Geopolitics 2024) ; assets/Undersea Power and Data Cables/List of .docx

properties.name: KAFOS data cable, Mangalia landing (approx.)
properties.note: 504 km fibre system linking Romania (Mangalia), Bulgaria (Varna) and Türkiye (Istanbul); active since 1997
properties.source: https://www.submarinecablemap.com/landing-point/mangalia-romania ; assets/Undersea Power and Data Cables/For the Telecommunications Network (KAFOS, RoBul).docx (submarinecablemap.com capture) ; assets/Undersea Power and Data Cables/List of .docx

properties.name: Romanian EEZ outer boundary (approx.)
properties.note: North/east: 2009 ICJ Romania v. Ukraine line around Snake Island; south: lateral boundary with Bulgaria from Vama Veche

properties.name: Midia: Ana gas platform (approx.)
properties.note: Black Sea Oil & Gas; ~120 km offshore, 70 m water depth

properties.name: Midia: Doina subsea well (approx.)
properties.note: Subsea production, 18 km tie-back to Ana

properties.name: Midia gas pipeline Ana to Vadu/Corbu (approx.)
properties.note: ~126 km (121 km subsea) to the gas treatment plant at Vadu/Corbu
properties.source: https://www.blackseaog.com/black-sea-oil-gas-completes-the-installation-of-the-ana-gas-production-platform-in-the-black-sea/ ; assets/Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms/List of Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms.docx

properties.name: Petrom: Lebăda Est platform (approx.)
properties.note: OMV Petrom shallow-water oil and gas field, producing since the late 1980s

properties.name: Petrom: Lebăda Vest platform (approx.)
properties.note: OMV Petrom shallow-water field

properties.name: Petrom: Sinoe field (approx.)
properties.note: OMV Petrom; production since 1999 (Gloria platform removed)

properties.name: Petrom: Pescăruș field (approx.)
properties.note: OMV Petrom; production since 2003

properties.name: Petrom: Delta 4 field (approx.)
properties.note: OMV Petrom; production since 2009

properties.name: Petrom Istria gas/oil pipeline to Midia (approx.)
properties.note: Shallow-water field network to the Midia/Năvodari shore

properties.name: Galata gas field platform, Bulgaria (approx.)
properties.note: ~25 km SE of Varna; also gas storage

properties.name: Kaliakra gas field, Bulgaria (approx.)
properties.note: Subsea wellhead tied back to Galata

properties.name: Kamchia gas field, Bulgaria (approx.)

properties.name: Galata pipeline to shore south of Varna (approx.)
properties.note: ~20 km offshore pipeline to the beach landing south of Varna

properties.name: Sakarya gas field, Tuna-1, Türkiye (approx.)

properties.name: Sakarya pipeline to Filyos (approx.)

properties.name: TurkStream gas pipeline (approx.)

properties.name: Odesa gas field platforms (Boyko towers), Ukraine (approx.)

properties.name: Golitsyn gas field, Ukraine (approx.)

properties.name: Odesa/Golitsyn gas pipeline to Crimea shore (approx.)
properties.note: Offshore gathering line to the Tarkhankut shore

properties.name: Caucasus Cable System, Poti to Balchik (approx.)
properties.note: ~1,182 km fibre system, Georgia to Bulgaria, laid 2008

properties.name: Diamond Link Global, Poti to Constanța (planned, approx.)

properties.name: XV Midia block (approx.)

properties.name: XVIII Istria block (approx.)
properties.note: OMV Petrom 100%; shallow-water producing fields (Lebăda, Sinoe, Pescăruș, Delta)
properties.source: assets/Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms/Neptune Deep Project.docx (block maps)

properties.name: XIII Pelican block (approx.)
properties.note: Black Sea Oil & Gas; Eugenia 1 discovery (2012)
properties.source: assets/Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms/Neptune Deep Project.docx (block maps) ; https://www.naturalgasworld.com/carlyle-to-resume-black-sea-drilling-36993

properties.name: EX-30 Trident block (approx.)

properties.name: ITUR data cable, Odesa to Istanbul (approx.)
properties.note: Italy-Türkiye-Ukraine-Russia system (1996); crosses the Romanian EEZ; current status unconfirmed

properties.name: Neptun Alpha production platform (approx.)
properties.note: Installed July 2026 in ~120 m of water, ~160 km offshore; self-powered; processes Domino and Pelican Sud gas; first gas 2027
properties.source: https://www.omv.com/en/media/press-releases/2026/progress-on-the-neptun-deep-project-the-offshore-production-platform-has-been-installed-in-the-black-sea ; assets/Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms/List of Offshore Energy and Gas Platforms.docx

properties.name: Neptun Deep infield lines Domino and Pelican Sud (approx.)
properties.note: Interfield subsea pipelines and umbilicals to Neptun Alpha

properties.name: Black Sea shore to Podișor gas pipeline (onshore, approx.)
properties.note: Transgaz, ~308 km onshore: Tuzla, Amzacea, Vlașin, Podișor (BRUA link); crosses Constanța, Călărași, Giurgiu; under construction

properties.name: Port of Midia (approx.)
properties.note: Satellite port ~13.5 nmi north of Constanța; crude oil and petroleum products, petrochemical facilities
properties.source: assets/Seaports and Naval Defense/List of Ports and Harbors.docx

properties.name: Port of Mangalia (approx.)
properties.note: Satellite port south of Constanța, part of the Constanța maritime port system
properties.source: assets/Seaports and Naval Defense/List of Ports and Harbors.docx

properties.name: Constanța Main Naval Base and Fleet Command (approx.)
properties.note: Romanian Naval Forces headquarters; also hosts the 'Mircea cel Bătrân' Naval Academy; Romania contributes to the MCM Black Sea Task Group (mine clearance)
properties.source: assets/Seaports and Naval Defense/List of Ports and Harbors.docx

properties.name: Capu Midia firing range (approx.)
properties.note: Naval and coastal defence range (4K51 Rubezh anti-ship missiles, Patriot and NATO drone-defence tests)
properties.source: https://english.mapn.ro/cpresa/4747_Capu-Midia-Beach-Under-Attack ; assets/Seaports and Naval Defense/List of Ports and Harbors.docx
